# external Postgres dependency may skip or fail tests

Tests are conditioned on reaching a Postgres instance (skipping the suite if unreachable). This creates an external environmental dependency that can cause tests to be skipped or flaky if Postgres is not available.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_verify.py` — `tests.test_verify._db_available`
